sn35.16:2.1: paccaññāsiṁ → abbhaññāsiṁ (sya-all, pts) | yāvakīvañcāhaṁ → yāva kivañcāham (pts) | channaṁ bāhirānaṁ āyatanānaṁ → channam bāhīrānam āyatanānam (pts) | nissaraṇato → nissarānato (pts)
sn35.16:2.3: vimutti → cetovimutti (bj) | vimutti ayamantimā → cetovimutti ayam antimā (pts) | natthi dāni punabbhavoti catutthaṁ → natthidāni punabbhavo ti (pts)
